answer.text:
Shared0 files
Finding a true dedicated desktop gaming microphone under ₹2,000 in India is challenging, as entry-level streaming USB mics like the Fifine AmpliGame A6VGo to product viewer dialog for this item. or Maono AU-PM461TRGo to product viewer dialog for this item. usually start around ₹2,500 to ₹3,000. However, you can get reliable clip-on or budget desktop options that work decently well for starting out.
Top Recommendations Under ₹2,000
Boya BY-M1Go to product viewer dialog for this item.: The most popular entry-level clip-on lapel microphone in India. It features a long 6-meter cord and a smartphone/camera switch. While it picks up surrounding room noise easily, it provides much cleaner vocal audio than a cheap laptop/earphone mic.
Maono AU-100Go to product viewer dialog for this item.: Another great lavalier alternative featuring a flat frequency response and built-in battery power for better gain control. It clips securely to your shirt and keeps the mic close to your mouth.
Fifine K669BGo to product viewer dialog for this item.: Though it occasionally ticks slightly above ₹2,000 depending on sales on Amazon India, this USB desktop condenser microphone offers a dedicated volume knob and much richer, fuller sound profile compared to lapel mics if you can stretch your budget slightly.

revisions.reason: consistency ruling made before the harness was run: the protocol classes a citation by its URL host, and an opaque Google /goto redirect shows none. Half the labellers read the class off the provider card instead; the card is not reliable in these payloads (the same set holds citations whose title and source describe a different page than their URL), so rule 6 applies: not sure, therefore other.
